title: Minor-Child and School-Child Additions in Disability Compensation Past-Due from Rating Decisions
content:
**Rule.** The child additions in a Disability Compensation decision past-due are one child addition for each recorded minor child plus one school-child addition for each recorded school child when the award records both; one child addition for each recorded minor child when it records minor children and no school child; one school-child addition for each recorded school child when it records school children and no minor child; and nothing when it records no child.

**Recorded children.** Minor children recorded are the child additions on the award less the child removals; school children recorded are the school-child additions less the school-child removals. Every month a decision past-due covers counts the children so recorded.

**Rates.** A standing month paid at the individual unemployability rate takes the 100 percent tier's child addition of 146.10 and school-child addition of 472.95; any other standing month takes the award's own tier.

**Combinations (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating), a month at the veteran-alone rate)**

| Recorded | Additions for that month |
|---|---|
| 1 minor child, 1 school child | 73.05 plus 236.48, that is 309.53 |
| 2 minor children | 73.05 multiplied by 2, that is 146.10 |
| 1 school child | 236.48 |
| A child added, then removed on reaching the age limit; nothing else | Nothing |
